description: This file defines the AssetDetailsPage React component, responsible for rendering detailed information about an asset, including tabs for different modules like Asset Details, Site Assets, Input EF Mapping, and Throughput Setup. It manages state, fetches data from API endpoints, and renders various UI elements such as breadcrumbs, loaders, and data tables.

methods.name: AssetDetailsPage
methods.description: Main React component function that renders the asset details page, manages state and effects for data fetching, and controls UI interactions.

methods.name: loadMappings
methods.description: Asynchronous function to load EF source mappings for the current asset and input parameter ID, updating state and showing toast notifications.
